messages.author: 20b85f1355a29c07
messages.subject: problem publishing app using ggplot2
parts:
I have just start using shiny.  I had published a first [app](https://ubpdqn.shinyapps.io/fuel). I have written some others but have been unable to deploy (or even update the original  app). 

I receive the following error (and execution is halted):

Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 298629920 failed: Error building image: Error fetching ggplot2 (2.2.0) source. Error accessing GitHub repository hadley/ggplot2. HTTP 301: Moved Permanently
Execution halted

I assume that there is an issue with the version of ggplot2 package I have installed. I have tried to update, force re-install to no avail.  

The apps run without problem in RStudio. I am using:  R version 3.3.1 (2016-06-21) on Windows 10.

I would appreciate any advice.

Yours sincerely,
ubpdqn

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: problem publishing app using ggplot2
parts:
There is a bug in shinyapps.io that does not deal with renamed/moved GitHub projects.
hadley/ggplot2 has moved to tidyverse/ggplot2.
While I am working on fixing the bug, you should be able to reinstall from the new location or CRAN to make progress.
I will update this thread when the fix is deployed.
